import { Nn as PicodashPersistenceDriver } from "./index-HD_xyHBR.mjs";
export interface PicodashWebStorage {
  getItem(key: string): string | null;
  setItem(key: string, value: string): void;
  removeItem(key: string): void;
}
export type PicodashWebStorageSource = 'local' | 'session' | PicodashWebStorage;
export declare function createWebStoragePersistenceDriver(source: PicodashWebStorageSource): PicodashPersistenceDriver;
